findings.path: <location within the repo incl. line, e.g. src/main/java/.../File.java:83>
findings.title: <full claim/description, verbatim, untruncated, no trailing ellipsis>
also_affects: <other repo/path:line this systemic defect affects — omit the field entirely for single-site findings>
findings.cwe_canonical: <CWE-NNN — a real mapped CWE, never CWE-0/none>
findings.fix: <one/two-sentence remediation for THIS finding, or null if genuinely none>
findings.pc_reason: <PRESENT ONLY when severity=PRIORITIZED_CRITICAL: why this qualifies as a PC-1 (four-clause justification). Omit/null otherwise.>
